keyPoints.en: Timber (meranti, keruing, cengal) and non-timber products (rattan, bamboo, resin, honey, herbs like tongkat ali).
keyPoints.bm: Kayu balak (meranti, keruing, cengal) dan hasil bukan kayu (rotan, buluh, damar, madu, herba seperti tongkat ali).

keyPoints.en: Management ensures a lasting supply, protects water catchments, prevents erosion and floods and conserves biodiversity.
keyPoints.bm: Pengurusan memastikan bekalan berterusan, melindungi kawasan tadahan air, mencegah hakisan dan banjir serta memulihara kepelbagaian biologi.

keyPoints.en: Permanent Reserved Forests, selective logging, reforestation, forest plantations, enforcement and public awareness.
keyPoints.bm: Hutan Simpanan Kekal, pembalakan terpilih, penghutanan semula, ladang hutan, penguatkuasaan dan kesedaran awam.

keyPoints.en: JPSM (Peninsula), Sabah and Sarawak forest departments, FRIM (research), PERHILITAN (wildlife, national parks).
keyPoints.bm: JPSM (Semenanjung), jabatan hutan Sabah dan Sarawak, FRIM (penyelidikan), PERHILITAN (hidupan liar, taman negara).
